title: Final Assessment N1 — Phonics & Reading
summary: Valider phonics (CVC, voyelles courtes), vocabulaire de base, prépositions, be/can, compréhension de mini-texte.
subject: Langue Anglaise
learningObjectives: Lire des CVC et phrases courtes

introduction.title: Consignes
introduction.content: Lis calmement. Repère les **sons** et **mots outils**.

mainContent.title: Part 1 — Phonics
mainContent.content: Lis 10 CVC : **cat, pen, pig, box, sun, map, bed, fish (fi-sh), dog, bus**.

mainContent.title: Part 2 — Phrases
mainContent.content: **The cat is under the chair.** **It is rainy. I wear a coat.** **I can jump.**

mainContent.title: Mini-texte
mainContent.content: It is Saturday. Anna is at home. She can read a book. The cat is on the bed.

examples.code: Saturday / home / read / on the bed
examples.title: Mots clés

mainContent.title: Questions
mainContent.content: 1) Where is Anna? 2) What can she do? 3) Where is the cat?

mainContent.title: Vérifie
mainContent.content: CVC, sight words, prépositions, be/can, compréhension.

conclusion.summary: Bravo 🎉 Tu termines le niveau **N1** en anglais.
nextSteps: Passer à **N2** : lectures un peu plus longues
